sanskrit_verse:
गवादिषु प्रणष्टेषु द्रव्येष्वपहृतेषु वा
पदेनान्वेषणं कुर्युरामूलात्तद्विदो जनाः
transliteration: gavādiṣu praṇaṣṭeṣu dravyeṣv apahṛteṣu vā / padenānveṣaṇaṃ kuryur ā mūlāt tadvido janāḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: When cows and other sacred possessions are lost or stolen, those who know the truth shall initiate a search based on precise identification, tracing the matter back to its root cause.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from knowledge of the essential nature of things
Causation is traced through sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ)
Capacity-based responsibility lies with those capable of discernment
Restoration logic requires tracing loss to its originating disruption
Consciousness alignment demands truthful inquiry untainted by punitive intent
executable_legal_axioms: IF property classified as 'sacred' (gavādi) is reported missing THEN initiate traceability protocol using witness testimony AND material evidence
IF loss involves sentient or sacred entities THEN assign investigation to agents trained in dharma-based discernment
IF origin of loss remains untraced THEN escalate inquiry to foundational causal layer via recursive questioning
NO punitive inference SHALL precede full causal reconstruction
ALL investigative actions MUST align with consciousness-preserving integrity protocols
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when disputes involve sacred or foundational assets like cattle, land, or ritual instruments, judges must invoke root-cause inquiry protocols derived from authoritative witnesses rather than circumstantial inference. Responsibility is assigned only after complete causal tracing has been executed.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This verse establishes pramāṇa-based causality where identification ('pada') leads to verifiable tracing ('anveṣaṇa'). The process follows anupūrvaśaḥ—sequential manifestation—from effect back to root cause. Responsibility arises only upon completion of this non-speculative path, ensuring alignment with non-punitive reality rule.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate witness-led retracing until original location or custodian is identified
Assign dharmic mediators to restore disrupted relationships between parties
Reintegrate displaced objects into their rightful functional context without blame attribution
Restore capacity of affected individuals to maintain future safeguarding awareness
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Truthful inquiry restores order; consciousness alone adjudicates; there is no punishment—only realignment.
